data.title: Income tax assessment 2025 – €634 to pay
data.summary: Finanzamt Neu-Musterdorf issued the income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) for 2025 on 26 March 2026. Tax is €11,405.00; after withheld wage tax there is an additional payment of €634.00 due by 30 April 2026.
data.explanation: This is your final income tax assessment for 2025. Withheld wage tax was €10,771.00, so you owe €634.00 more. Pay it by 30 April 2026 to the account shown, using the stated reference. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Einspruch) with the tax office; the app shows the deadline. Note the letter says it was posted on 30 March 2026, although dated 26 March. If unsure, consider advice from a tax adviser.
